quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs are yellow with black symbols or words. They warn you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Wrong-way entry to one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way entry to one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in one direction only. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of an upcoming winding road with three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve. The arrow points in the direction the road curves. Multiple chevron signs mark a curve.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of what?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only flow in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On roads with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering. Move to another lane if no one is next to you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign alerts you to a traffic signal ahead. Be ready to stop for red or yellow lights and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has a low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let merging traffic in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. This sign means U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are merging into one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering your lane from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles are likely present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and get ready to stop.
Come to a complete stop, then proceed if safe.
Proceed carefully, but you may not need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then proceed if safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop and only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be prepared to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the exact speed shown.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows laws drivers must follow. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet because it may be slippery and hard to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait until it is safe before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign has this shape and color?
questions.explanation: Only pennant-shaped warning signs are used to mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is only for buses and cars with multiple passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic must flow on this street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you must stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop or slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that the road has low overhead clearance.

questions.question: What is the main danger when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
Your car could hydroplane if the shoulder has water.
You could lose control if your vehicle drifts onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if your vehicle drifts onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or drive straight through.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You can either continue or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane ends and becomes an exit ramp. You must exit if you stay in this lane. You can change lanes if you want to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area. Be alert and give them space.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. You cannot turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is split into two separate directions. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign is white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey it. Do not pass other vehicles where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay on the side the arrow shows.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first. You must yield the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or rail between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards and road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a sharp turn. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit is the maximum legal speed for that road in good conditions. You should drive slower if the road or weather is poor.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm out with palm down and then swings it down to their side, it signals the group to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers a steep hill is coming and they should be ready to adjust their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does it mean when a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points upward?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when they do not have turn signals. A bent left arm with the hand pointing up means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger while riding in a group?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, all riders should form a single-file line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They warn drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign tells drivers a lane is ending and they need to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign means the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Drive carefully in rain or wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, watch for deer, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does a stop sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and stop only if other cars are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
Go through carefully without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield to all traffic and pedestrians. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards. This sign means a school is ahead. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, it tells the group to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep downhill ahead. Adjust your speed to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for you, so you must wait for them to pass.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic signal tells left-turning drivers to wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you may either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not allowed wherever it is posted.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider bends their left arm at the elbow and points downward, it signals that they plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road conditions ahead. This sign means traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn you about railroad crossings. This sign means a train crossing is ahead. Look for trains before crossing.

questions.question: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway ahead is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in a group. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings the arm upward, it means increase your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows an intersection ahead. A road comes in from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Drive carefully where pedestrians may cross.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intent to turn or stop. When you extend your left arm straight out, it means you will turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm extended straight out signals a left turn or lane change to the left.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: A left arm bent at the elbow with the hand pointing upward signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must watch for children and be prepared to stop. Always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you the divided highway is ending. Watch for oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross here. Slow down and be ready to stop for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a divided highway is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Reduce your speed to the safe speed shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all traffic and pedestrians to clear before moving.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved only for people with valid disabled parking permits.

questions.question: From bottom to top, traffic light colors are arranged as:
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged from bottom to top as green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
